source: build-genus-geo's base SUBUNITS + the 12 *-l4-table.json subunit tables + genus-geo.json (WGSRPD level 2/1, unioned over 153 genera) + places.json (admin/country) + shapes.json (the site's own continent vocabulary)
note: One published hierarchy over the site's place keys, so the journal map's zoom views need not carry a copy of the subunit table. `parent` is a level-4 subunit's WGSRPD level-3 unit. `country` is ABSENT for a place spanning more than one country (see multiCountry). `region` is ABSENT where the place is not a WGSRPD unit at all — the consumer should fall back to a group of one named after the place, which is what the genus map does.
continentVocabulary: the site's own (Africa / Asia / Oceania / North America / Central America / Caribbean / South America), NOT WGSRPD level 1
